snippet.title: Delver Quest: A New Action Platformer for the NES!
snippet.description:
Homebrew campaign is now live!
https://www.homebrew-factory.com/nes/148-delver-quest-nes.html

Soundtrack on Spotify:
https://open.spotify.com/album/4Ut5GEO6MsQ4Gcqzf6TveX?si=jOWJnvoLQ_eSmBP2Q7vcCA

Announcing Delver Quest! A new action platformer for the NES!
Run, jump, and dive across four exciting worlds with many secrets to unlock! Challenge yourself to lower your time on each playthrough.
A built-in game cycle timer makes it easy to determine your fastest time for speed-running. Clever use of unlockable items exposes alternate routing through almost 200 levels of action!
